plugin.name: sh_report
plugin.author: Claude
plugin.purpose: Reports sorted, colour-coded SH-range (186-200) players to a channel
plugin.description:
Type: shreport [channel] (default channel: gt)
Sends "who 186 200", parses the results, ignores (FLAG)/[FLAG] tags, treats any non-numeric level marker (immortal titles, blank, etc.) as level 200, sorts everyone found from highest level to lowest, and broadcasts a colour-coded report to the given channel (or just "gt" if you don't name one). If nobody is found, it says so on the channel instead of staying silent.

muclient.script:
-- ====================================================================== -- sh_report: reports sorted SH-range (186-200) players to a channel -- ======================================================================
SH_waiting = SH_waiting or false SH_channel = SH_channel or "gt" SH_players = SH_players or {}
function OnPluginInstall() SH_waiting = false SH_channel = "gt" SH_players = {} end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- alias entry point: shreport [channel] -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
function SH_OnShReport(name, line, wildcards) local channel = wildcards[1] if not channel or channel == "" then channel = "gt" end
SH_channel = channel SH_players = {} SH_waiting = true
Send("who 186 200") end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- helpers -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Strips any number of leading "(FLAG)", "[FLAG]", or "*FLAG*" groups (and -- the whitespace right after them), eg. turns "(OPK) Obyron - ...", -- "[Helper] Trurien ...", or "*AFK* Tesobi ..." into "Obyron - ...", -- "Trurien ...", "Tesobi ...". local function SH_StripLeadingFlags(text) local changed = true while changed do changed = false
local rest = text:match("^%((.-)%)%s*(.*)$") if rest ~= nil then local _, captured = text:match("^%((.-)%)%s*(.*)$") text = captured changed = true else local captured = select(2, text:match("^%[(.-)%]%s*(.*)$")) if captured ~= nil then text = captured changed = true else captured = select(2, text:match("^%*(.-)%*%s*(.*)$")) if captured ~= nil then text = captured changed = true end end end end return text end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- trigger: capture one "[LVL race class] Name ..." line -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
function SH_CapturePlayerLine(name, line, wildcards) if not SH_waiting then return end
local levelRaw = wildcards[1] or "" local rest = wildcards[2] or ""
-- First 3 characters after "[": numeric means that's the level; -- anything else (blank, an immortal title like "HERO", etc.) counts -- as level 200. The trigger itself only matches lines where the -- bracket is exactly 15 characters wide (the real "who" listing -- format), which is what keeps this from also matching the player's -- own status prompt (eg. "[HP:93% ... [ Enemy: 43% ] Dbl: 9>"). local levelStr = levelRaw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local level = tonumber(levelStr) or 200
rest = SH_StripLeadingFlags(rest) local pname = rest:match("^(%S+)")
if pname then table.insert(SH_players, {name = pname, level = level}) end end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- trigger: "Players found: [n], ..." -- end of the who listing -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
function SH_Finalize(name, line, wildcards) if not SH_waiting then return end SH_waiting = false
table.sort(SH_players, function(a, b) if a.level ~= b.level then return a.level > b.level end return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower() end)
SH_SendReport() end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- build and send the coloured report -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
function SH_SendReport() local channel = SH_channel or "gt" local count = #SH_players local msg
if count == 0 then msg = channel .. " @CPlayers in SH range@D (@Y0@D)@D: @RNone found.@w" else local parts = {} for _, p in ipairs(SH_players) do table.insert(parts, "@Y" .. p.level .. "@D:@W" .. p.name) end msg = channel .. " @CPlayers in SH range@D (@Y" .. count .. "@D): " .. table.concat(parts, "@D, ") .. "@w" end
ColourNote( "cyan", "", "[SH Report]: Sending SH range report to " .. channel .. " (" .. count .. " found)..." )
SendNoEcho(msg) end
